Problem Statement:

turns.reply:
I changed `should_bypass_proxies` in `src/requests/utils.py` so `no_proxy` entries only match on domain boundaries, per bpo-39057. The relevant `test_utils.py` proxy/bypass tests pass (73 passed, 12 skipped), and the patch is submitted.

The hostname check now matches an entry only if it equals the hostname or host:port, or if the hostname or host:port ends with `.` plus the entry. A leading dot on an entry is stripped first. Previously a bare suffix match let `notexample.com` bypass the proxy for `example.com`.

I did not add a test case for the `notexample.com` boundary, since test files are off-limits here.
